title: The Entertainers packed every night; Creath sits in
summary: The band was the talk of New Orleans; Lee was glad to be home; the end of the tape loops garbled.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up under segregation: schools, neighborhoods, Jim Crow

blocks.x: And I go to work in Astoria, I mean entertainers, playing this band. And this was a band, that time was the talk of New Orleans. We kept it everything. Packed and jammed every night. Fake Marbles band was in there. And I got Zooty's wife's brother, Cornet Flair.

Cornet Flair would come and sit in Whitville. And things was going good, things was going good. Oh man, I was feeling fine. I didn't miss Chicago at all because I was back home, where the jazz played like I liked to hear it. And everybody was playing so good around New Orleans at that time. But a man, he was playing. But a man, he was playing. He had burned himself out of whiskey then. He wasn't doing so good. So he came in there. So he came in there.
